moves.10000000voltthunderbolt.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.10000000voltthunderbolt.flavor: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.10000000voltthunderbolt.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
moves.absorb.desc: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.absorb.flavor: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.absorb.name: Absorb
moves.accelerock.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.accelerock.flavor: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
moves.accelerock.name: Accelerock
moves.acid.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.acid.flavor: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.
moves.acid.name: Acid
moves.acidarmor.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
moves.acidarmor.flavor: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
moves.acidarmor.name: Acid Armor
moves.aciddownpour.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.aciddownpour.flavor: The user creates a poisonous swamp using its Z-Power and sinks the target into it at full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.aciddownpour.name: Acid Downpour
moves.acidspray.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.acidspray.flavor: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.acidspray.name: Acid Spray
moves.acrobatics.desc: Has double power if the user has no held item.
moves.acrobatics.flavor: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
moves.acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
moves.acupressure.desc: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.
moves.acupressure.flavor: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.
moves.acupressure.name: Acupressure
moves.aerialace.flavor: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.
moves.aerialace.name: Aerial Ace
moves.aeroblast.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.aeroblast.flavor: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.aeroblast.name: Aeroblast
moves.afteryou.desc: Makes the target act next this turn.
moves.afteryou.flavor: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
moves.afteryou.name: After You
moves.agility.desc: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
moves.agility.flavor: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.
moves.agility.name: Agility
moves.aircutter.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.aircutter.flavor: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.aircutter.name: Air Cutter
moves.airslash.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.airslash.flavor: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.airslash.name: Air Slash
moves.alloutpummeling.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.alloutpummeling.flavor: The user rams an energy orb created by its Z-Power into the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.alloutpummeling.name: All-Out Pummeling
moves.alluringvoice.flavor: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
moves.alluringvoice.name: Alluring Voice
moves.allyswitch.desc: User switches places with the friendly Pokémon opposite it.
moves.allyswitch.flavor: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.allyswitch.name: Ally Switch
moves.amnesia.desc: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.amnesia.flavor: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
moves.amnesia.name: Amnesia
moves.anchorshot.flavor: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.anchorshot.name: Anchor Shot
moves.ancientpower.desc: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
moves.ancientpower.flavor: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.
moves.ancientpower.name: Ancient Power
moves.appleacid.desc: Lower the targets Special Defense by 1 stage.
moves.appleacid.flavor: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.appleacid.name: Apple Acid
moves.aquacutter.flavor: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.aquacutter.name: Aqua Cutter
moves.aquajet.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.aquajet.flavor: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.aquajet.name: Aqua Jet
moves.aquaring.desc: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP each turn.
moves.aquaring.flavor: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
moves.aquaring.name: Aqua Ring
moves.aquastep.flavor: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
moves.aquastep.name: Aqua Step
moves.aquatail.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.aquatail.flavor: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
moves.aquatail.name: Aqua Tail
moves.armorcannon.flavor: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.armorcannon.name: Armor Cannon
moves.armthrust.flavor: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.armthrust.name: Arm Thrust
moves.aromatherapy.desc: Cures the entire party of major status effects.
moves.aromatherapy.flavor: This move can't be used. It's recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can't be remembered.
moves.aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
moves.aromaticmist.desc: Raises a selected ally’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.aromaticmist.flavor: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
moves.aromaticmist.name: Aromatic Mist
moves.assist.desc: Randomly selects and uses one of the trainer’s other Pokémon’s moves.
moves.assist.flavor: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by ally Pokémon.
moves.assist.name: Assist
moves.assurance.desc: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
moves.assurance.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.
moves.assurance.name: Assurance
moves.astonish.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.astonish.flavor: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.astonish.name: Astonish
moves.astralbarrage.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.astralbarrage.flavor: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.
moves.astralbarrage.name: Astral Barrage
moves.attackorder.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.attackorder.flavor: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.attackorder.name: Attack Order
moves.attract.desc: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.
moves.attract.flavor: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
moves.attract.name: Attract
moves.aurasphere.flavor: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
moves.aurasphere.name: Aura Sphere
moves.aurawheel.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage. In Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. In Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type.
moves.aurawheel.flavor: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.
moves.aurawheel.name: Aura Wheel
moves.aurorabeam.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.aurorabeam.flavor: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
moves.aurorabeam.name: Aurora Beam
moves.auroraveil.desc: Reduces damage five turns, but must be used during hail.
moves.auroraveil.flavor: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.
moves.auroraveil.name: Aurora Veil
moves.autotomize.desc: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages and halves the user’s weight.
moves.autotomize.flavor: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
moves.autotomize.name: Autotomize
moves.avalanche.desc: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
moves.avalanche.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
moves.avalanche.name: Avalanche
moves.axekick.flavor: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
moves.axekick.name: Axe Kick
moves.babydolleyes.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.babydolleyes.flavor: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
moves.babydolleyes.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.baddybad.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.baddybad.flavor: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon’s physical moves.
moves.baddybad.name: Baddy Bad
moves.banefulbunker.desc: Grants the user protection for the rest of the turn and poisons any Pokémon that tries to use a contact move on it.
moves.banefulbunker.flavor: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.banefulbunker.name: Baneful Bunker
moves.barbbarrage.flavor: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.
moves.barbbarrage.name: Barb Barrage
moves.barrage.flavor: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
moves.barrage.name: Barrage
moves.barrier.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
moves.barrier.flavor: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
moves.barrier.name: Barrier
moves.batonpass.desc: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.
moves.batonpass.flavor: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
moves.batonpass.name: Baton Pass
moves.beakblast.desc: Inflicts a burn on any Pokémon that makes contact before the attack.
moves.beakblast.flavor: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.
moves.beakblast.name: Beak Blast
moves.beatup.desc: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.
moves.beatup.flavor: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
moves.beatup.name: Beat Up
moves.behemothbash.desc: Deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.behemothbash.flavor: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.behemothbash.name: Behemoth Bash
moves.behemothblade.desc: Deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.behemothblade.flavor: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.behemothblade.name: Behemoth Blade
moves.belch.desc: Can only be used after the user has eaten a berry.
moves.belch.flavor: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
moves.belch.name: Belch
moves.bellydrum.desc: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.
moves.bellydrum.flavor: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.
moves.bellydrum.name: Belly Drum
moves.bestow.desc: Gives the user’s held item to the target.
moves.bestow.flavor: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn’t holding an item.
moves.bestow.name: Bestow
moves.bide.desc: User waits for two turns, then hits back for twice the damage it took.
moves.bide.flavor: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
moves.bide.name: Bide
moves.bind.desc: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.bind.flavor: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.bind.name: Bind
moves.bite.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.bite.flavor: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.bite.name: Bite
moves.bitterblade.flavor: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.bitterblade.name: Bitter Blade
moves.bittermalice.flavor: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.bittermalice.name: Bitter Malice
moves.blackholeeclipse.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.blackholeeclipse.flavor: The user gathers dark energy using its Z-Power and sucks the target into it. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.blackholeeclipse.name: Black Hole Eclipse
moves.blastburn.desc: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.blastburn.flavor: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.blastburn.name: Blast Burn
moves.blazekick.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to burn the target.
moves.blazekick.flavor: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.blazekick.name: Blaze Kick
moves.blazingtorque.name: Blazing Torque
moves.bleakwindstorm.flavor: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.
moves.bleakwindstorm.name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.blizzard.desc: Has a chance to freeze the target.
moves.blizzard.flavor: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
moves.blizzard.name: Blizzard
moves.block.desc: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
moves.block.flavor: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.
moves.block.name: Block
moves.bloodmoon.flavor: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.
moves.bloodmoon.name: Blood Moon
moves.bloomdoom.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.bloomdoom.flavor: The user collects energy from plants using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.bloomdoom.name: Bloom Doom
moves.blueflare.desc: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.blueflare.flavor: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.blueflare.name: Blue Flare
moves.bodypress.desc: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes.
moves.bodypress.flavor: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
moves.bodypress.name: Body Press
moves.bodyslam.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.bodyslam.flavor: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.bodyslam.name: Body Slam
moves.boltbeak.desc: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.
moves.boltbeak.flavor: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.
moves.boltbeak.name: Bolt Beak
moves.boltstrike.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.boltstrike.flavor: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.boltstrike.name: Bolt Strike
moves.boneclub.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.boneclub.flavor: The user clubs the target with a bone. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.boneclub.name: Bone Club
moves.bonemerang.flavor: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.
moves.bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
moves.bonerush.flavor: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.bonerush.name: Bone Rush
moves.boomburst.flavor: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.
moves.boomburst.name: Boomburst
moves.bounce.desc: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
moves.bounce.flavor: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.bounce.name: Bounce
moves.bouncybubble.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.bouncybubble.flavor: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.bouncybubble.name: Bouncy Bubble
moves.branchpoke.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.branchpoke.flavor: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.
moves.branchpoke.name: Branch Poke
moves.bravebird.desc: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.bravebird.flavor: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.bravebird.name: Brave Bird
moves.breakingswipe.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.breakingswipe.flavor: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
moves.breakingswipe.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.breakneckblitz.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.breakneckblitz.flavor: The user builds up its momentum using its Z-Power and crashes into the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.breakneckblitz.name: Breakneck Blitz
moves.brickbreak.flavor: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
moves.brickbreak.name: Brick Break
moves.brine.desc: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.
moves.brine.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.
moves.brine.name: Brine
moves.brutalswing.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.brutalswing.flavor: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
moves.brutalswing.name: Brutal Swing
moves.bubble.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.bubble.flavor: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stat.
moves.bubble.name: Bubble
moves.bubblebeam.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.bubblebeam.flavor: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.
moves.bubblebeam.name: Bubble Beam
moves.bugbite.desc: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
moves.bugbite.flavor: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
moves.bugbite.name: Bug Bite
moves.bugbuzz.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.bugbuzz.flavor: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.bugbuzz.name: Bug Buzz
moves.bulkup.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
moves.bulkup.flavor: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.
moves.bulkup.name: Bulk Up
moves.bulldoze.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.bulldoze.flavor: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
moves.bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
moves.bulletpunch.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.bulletpunch.flavor: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
moves.bulletpunch.name: Bullet Punch
moves.bulletseed.flavor: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.bulletseed.name: Bullet Seed
moves.burningbulwark.flavor: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
moves.burningbulwark.name: Burning Bulwark
moves.burningjealousy.desc: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.
moves.burningjealousy.flavor: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
moves.burningjealousy.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.burnup.desc: Removes the user’s Fire type after inflicting damage.
moves.burnup.flavor: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
moves.burnup.name: Burn Up
moves.buzzybuzz.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.buzzybuzz.flavor: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.buzzybuzz.name: Buzzy Buzz
moves.calmmind.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.calmmind.flavor: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
moves.calmmind.name: Calm Mind
moves.camouflage.desc: User’s type changes to match the terrain.
moves.camouflage.flavor: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.
moves.camouflage.name: Camouflage
moves.captivate.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages if it’s the opposite gender.
moves.captivate.flavor: If any opposing Pokémon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.
moves.captivate.name: Captivate
moves.catastropika.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.catastropika.flavor: The user, Pikachu, surrounds itself with the maximum amount of electricity using its Z-Power and pounces on its target with full force.
moves.catastropika.name: Catastropika
moves.ceaselessedge.flavor: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.
moves.ceaselessedge.name: Ceaseless Edge
moves.celebrate.flavor: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
moves.celebrate.name: Celebrate
moves.charge.desc: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
moves.charge.flavor: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
moves.charge.name: Charge
moves.chargebeam.desc: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.chargebeam.flavor: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.chargebeam.name: Charge Beam
moves.charm.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
moves.charm.flavor: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.charm.name: Charm
moves.chatter.desc: Has a higher chance to confuse the target when the recorded sound is louder.
moves.chatter.flavor: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.
moves.chatter.name: Chatter
moves.chillingwater.flavor: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.chillingwater.name: Chilling Water
moves.chillyreception.flavor: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
moves.chillyreception.name: Chilly Reception
moves.chipaway.flavor: Looking for an opening, the user strikes consistently. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.
moves.chipaway.name: Chip Away
moves.chloroblast.flavor: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.
moves.chloroblast.name: Chloroblast
moves.circlethrow.desc: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.circlethrow.flavor: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.circlethrow.name: Circle Throw
moves.clamp.desc: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.clamp.flavor: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
moves.clamp.name: Clamp
moves.clangingscales.desc: Lowers the user’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.clangingscales.flavor: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.
moves.clangingscales.name: Clanging Scales
moves.clangoroussoul.desc: User loses 33% of its Max HP. Raises all of the user’s stats by one stage.
moves.clangoroussoul.flavor: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.
moves.clangoroussoul.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.clangoroussoulblaze.desc: Inflicts damage to all opposing Pokémon and increases the user’s Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.
moves.clangoroussoulblaze.flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user’s stats.
moves.clangoroussoulblaze.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
moves.clearsmog.desc: Removes all of the target’s stat modifiers.
moves.clearsmog.flavor: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.
moves.clearsmog.name: Clear Smog
moves.closecombat.desc: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.closecombat.flavor: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.closecombat.name: Close Combat
moves.coaching.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
moves.coaching.flavor: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
moves.coaching.name: Coaching
moves.coil.desc: Raises the user’s Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.
moves.coil.flavor: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
moves.coil.name: Coil
moves.collisioncourse.flavor: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.
moves.collisioncourse.name: Collision Course
moves.combattorque.name: Combat Torque
moves.cometpunch.flavor: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
moves.cometpunch.name: Comet Punch
moves.comeuppance.flavor: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
moves.comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
moves.confide.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.confide.flavor: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.confide.name: Confide
moves.confuseray.flavor: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.
moves.confuseray.name: Confuse Ray
moves.confusion.desc: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.confusion.flavor: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.
moves.confusion.name: Confusion
moves.constrict.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.constrict.flavor: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
moves.constrict.name: Constrict
moves.continentalcrush.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.continentalcrush.flavor: The user summons a huge rock mountain using its Z-Power and drops it onto the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.continentalcrush.name: Continental Crush
moves.conversion.desc: User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves at random.
moves.conversion.flavor: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.
moves.conversion.name: Conversion
moves.conversion2.desc: Changes the user’s type to a random type either resistant or immune to the last move used against it.
moves.conversion2.flavor: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the move the target used last.
moves.conversion2.name: Conversion 2
moves.copycat.desc: Uses the target’s last used move.
moves.copycat.flavor: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
moves.copycat.name: Copycat
moves.coreenforcer.desc: Nullifies the target’s ability if it moves earlier.
moves.coreenforcer.flavor: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.
moves.coreenforcer.name: Core Enforcer
moves.corkscrewcrash.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.corkscrewcrash.flavor: The user spins very fast and rams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.corkscrewcrash.name: Corkscrew Crash
moves.corrosivegas.flavor: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
moves.corrosivegas.name: Corrosive Gas
moves.cosmicpower.desc: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.cosmicpower.flavor: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.cosmicpower.name: Cosmic Power
moves.cottonguard.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by three stages.
moves.cottonguard.flavor: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.
moves.cottonguard.name: Cotton Guard
moves.cottonspore.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.cottonspore.flavor: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.
moves.cottonspore.name: Cotton Spore
moves.counter.desc: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last physical hit it took.
moves.counter.flavor: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.
moves.counter.name: Counter
moves.courtchange.desc: Switches single sided field effects from the users side to the targets side and vice versa.
moves.courtchange.flavor: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
moves.courtchange.name: Court Change
moves.covet.flavor: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
moves.covet.name: Covet
moves.crabhammer.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.crabhammer.flavor: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
moves.craftyshield.desc: Protects all friendly Pokémon from non-damaging moves.
moves.craftyshield.flavor: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.
moves.craftyshield.name: Crafty Shield
moves.crosschop.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.crosschop.flavor: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.crosschop.name: Cross Chop
moves.crosspoison.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
moves.crosspoison.flavor: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.crosspoison.name: Cross Poison
moves.crunch.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.crunch.flavor: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.crunch.name: Crunch
moves.crushclaw.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.crushclaw.flavor: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.crushclaw.name: Crush Claw
moves.crushgrip.desc: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
moves.crushgrip.flavor: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
moves.crushgrip.name: Crush Grip
moves.curse.desc: Ghosts pay half their max HP to hurt the target every turn. Others decrease Speed but raise Attack and Defense.
moves.curse.flavor: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.
moves.curse.name: Curse
moves.cut.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.cut.flavor: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.
moves.cut.name: Cut
moves.darkestlariat.flavor: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
moves.darkestlariat.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.darkpulse.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.darkpulse.flavor: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
moves.darkvoid.flavor: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that puts them to sleep.
moves.darkvoid.name: Dark Void
moves.dazzlinggleam.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.dazzlinggleam.flavor: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
moves.dazzlinggleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.decorate.desc: Raise the targets Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
moves.decorate.flavor: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
moves.decorate.name: Decorate
moves.defendorder.desc: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
moves.defendorder.flavor: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, boosting its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.defendorder.name: Defend Order
moves.defensecurl.desc: Raises user’s Defense by one stage.
moves.defensecurl.flavor: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.
moves.defensecurl.name: Defense Curl
moves.defog.desc: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Removes field effects from the enemy field.
moves.defog.flavor: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
moves.defog.name: Defog
moves.destinybond.desc: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
moves.destinybond.flavor: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.destinybond.name: Destiny Bond
moves.detect.desc: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
moves.detect.flavor: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.detect.name: Detect
moves.devastatingdrake.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.devastatingdrake.flavor: The user materializes its aura using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.devastatingdrake.name: Devastating Drake
moves.diamondstorm.desc: Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by two stages for each target hit.
moves.diamondstorm.flavor: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also sharply boost the user's Defense stat.
moves.diamondstorm.name: Diamond Storm
moves.dig.desc: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
moves.dig.flavor: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
moves.dig.name: Dig
moves.direclaw.flavor: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.
moves.direclaw.name: Dire Claw
moves.disable.desc: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.
moves.disable.flavor: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.
moves.disable.name: Disable
moves.disarmingvoice.flavor: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.disarmingvoice.name: Disarming Voice
moves.discharge.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.discharge.flavor: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.
moves.discharge.name: Discharge
moves.dive.desc: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
moves.dive.flavor: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.
moves.dive.name: Dive
moves.dizzypunch.desc: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.dizzypunch.flavor: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This may also leave the target confused.
moves.dizzypunch.name: Dizzy Punch
moves.doodle.flavor: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.
moves.doodle.name: Doodle
moves.doomdesire.desc: Hits the target two turns later.
moves.doomdesire.flavor: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.
moves.doomdesire.name: Doom Desire
moves.doubleedge.desc: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.doubleedge.flavor: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.doubleedge.name: Double-Edge
moves.doublehit.flavor: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.doublehit.name: Double Hit
moves.doubleironbash.flavor: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.doubleironbash.name: Double Iron Bash
moves.doublekick.flavor: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.
moves.doublekick.name: Double Kick
moves.doubleshock.flavor: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
moves.doubleshock.name: Double Shock
moves.doubleslap.flavor: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.
moves.doubleslap.name: Double Slap
moves.doubleteam.desc: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.
moves.doubleteam.flavor: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.
moves.doubleteam.name: Double Team
moves.dracometeor.desc: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
moves.dracometeor.flavor: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.dracometeor.name: Draco Meteor
moves.dragonascent.desc: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.dragonascent.flavor: The user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
moves.dragonascent.name: Dragon Ascent
moves.dragonbreath.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.dragonbreath.flavor: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.dragonbreath.name: Dragon Breath
moves.dragoncheer.flavor: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
moves.dragoncheer.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.dragonclaw.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.dragonclaw.flavor: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.
moves.dragonclaw.name: Dragon Claw
moves.dragondance.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
moves.dragondance.flavor: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
moves.dragondance.name: Dragon Dance
moves.dragondarts.desc: Hits twice in one turn. In Double Battles, this move will hit both enemy targets. If it would fail to hit one of the targets, the other target will be hit twice.
moves.dragondarts.flavor: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
moves.dragondarts.name: Dragon Darts
moves.dragonenergy.desc: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
moves.dragonenergy.flavor: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
moves.dragonenergy.name: Dragon Energy
moves.dragonhammer.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.dragonhammer.flavor: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
moves.dragonhammer.name: Dragon Hammer
moves.dragonpulse.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.dragonpulse.flavor: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
moves.dragonpulse.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.dragonrage.flavor: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.
moves.dragonrage.name: Dragon Rage
moves.dragonrush.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.dragonrush.flavor: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.dragonrush.name: Dragon Rush
moves.dragontail.desc: Ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.dragontail.flavor: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.dragontail.name: Dragon Tail
moves.drainingkiss.desc: Drains 75% of the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.drainingkiss.flavor: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.
moves.drainingkiss.name: Draining Kiss
moves.drainpunch.desc: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.drainpunch.flavor: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.drainpunch.name: Drain Punch
moves.dreameater.desc: Only works on sleeping Pokémon. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.dreameater.flavor: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.dreameater.name: Dream Eater
moves.drillpeck.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.drillpeck.flavor: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.
moves.drillpeck.name: Drill Peck
moves.drillrun.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.drillrun.flavor: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.drillrun.name: Drill Run
moves.drumbeating.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.drumbeating.flavor: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
moves.drumbeating.name: Drum Beating
moves.dualchop.flavor: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.dualchop.name: Dual Chop
moves.dualwingbeat.flavor: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.dualwingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.dynamaxcannon.desc: Deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.
moves.dynamaxcannon.flavor: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.
moves.dynamaxcannon.name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.dynamicpunch.desc: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.dynamicpunch.flavor: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
moves.dynamicpunch.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.earthpower.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.earthpower.flavor: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.earthpower.name: Earth Power
moves.earthquake.desc: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
moves.earthquake.flavor: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
moves.earthquake.name: Earthquake
moves.echoedvoice.desc: Power increases by 100% for each consecutive use by any friendly Pokémon, to a maximum of 200.
moves.echoedvoice.flavor: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.
moves.echoedvoice.name: Echoed Voice
moves.eerieimpulse.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages.
moves.eerieimpulse.flavor: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.eerieimpulse.name: Eerie Impulse
moves.eeriespell.desc: The target loses 3 PP from the last move it used.
moves.eeriespell.flavor: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
moves.eeriespell.name: Eerie Spell
moves.eggbomb.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.eggbomb.flavor: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.
moves.eggbomb.name: Egg Bomb
moves.electricterrain.desc: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.
moves.electricterrain.flavor: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
moves.electricterrain.name: Electric Terrain
moves.electrify.desc: Changes the target’s move’s type to Electric if it hasn’t moved yet this turn.
moves.electrify.flavor: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.
moves.electrify.name: Electrify
moves.electroball.desc: Power is higher when the user has greater Speed than the target, up to a maximum of 150.
moves.electroball.flavor: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.electroball.name: Electro Ball
moves.electrodrift.flavor: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
moves.electrodrift.name: Electro Drift
moves.electroshot.flavor: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
moves.electroshot.name: Electro Shot
moves.electroweb.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.electroweb.flavor: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.
moves.electroweb.name: Electroweb
moves.embargo.flavor: This move prevents the target from using its held item for five turns. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
moves.embargo.name: Embargo
moves.ember.desc: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.ember.flavor: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.ember.name: Ember
moves.encore.desc: Forces the target to repeat its last used move every turn for 2 to 6 turns.
moves.encore.flavor: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
moves.encore.name: Encore
moves.endeavor.desc: Lowers the target’s HP to equal the user’s.
moves.endeavor.flavor: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.
moves.endeavor.name: Endeavor
moves.endure.desc: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.
moves.endure.flavor: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
moves.endure.name: Endure
moves.energyball.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.energyball.flavor: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.energyball.name: Energy Ball
moves.entrainment.desc: Copies the user’s ability onto the target.
moves.entrainment.flavor: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.
moves.entrainment.name: Entrainment
moves.eruption.desc: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
moves.eruption.flavor: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
moves.eruption.name: Eruption
moves.esperwing.flavor: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.esperwing.name: Esper Wing
moves.eternabeam.desc: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.eternabeam.flavor: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.
moves.eternabeam.name: Eternabeam
moves.expandingforce.desc: If Psychic Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power incrased by 50%.
moves.expandingforce.flavor: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
moves.expandingforce.name: Expanding Force
moves.explosion.flavor: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.explosion.name: Explosion
moves.extrasensory.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.extrasensory.flavor: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
moves.extremeevoboost.desc: Raises all of the user’s stats by two stages.
moves.extremeevoboost.flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts its stats sharply.
moves.extremeevoboost.name: Extreme Evoboost
moves.extremespeed.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.extremespeed.flavor: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.extremespeed.name: Extreme Speed
moves.facade.desc: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
moves.facade.flavor: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
moves.facade.name: Facade
moves.fairylock.desc: Prevents all Pokémon from fleeing or switching out during the next turn.
moves.fairylock.flavor: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
moves.fairylock.name: Fairy Lock
moves.fairywind.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.fairywind.flavor: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.
moves.fairywind.name: Fairy Wind
moves.fakeout.desc: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle. Causes the target to flinch.
moves.fakeout.flavor: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
moves.fakeout.name: Fake Out
moves.faketears.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.faketears.flavor: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.faketears.name: Fake Tears
moves.falsesurrender.flavor: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.
moves.falsesurrender.name: False Surrender
moves.falseswipe.desc: Cannot lower the target’s HP below 1.
moves.falseswipe.flavor: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
moves.falseswipe.name: False Swipe
