moves.horndrill.flavor: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
moves.horndrill.name: Horn Drill
moves.hornleech.desc: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.hornleech.flavor: The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.hornleech.name: Horn Leech
moves.howl.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
moves.howl.flavor: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.
moves.howl.name: Howl
moves.hurricane.desc: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.hurricane.flavor: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.
moves.hurricane.name: Hurricane
moves.hydrocannon.desc: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.hydrocannon.flavor: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.hydrocannon.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.hydropump.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.hydropump.flavor: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
moves.hydropump.name: Hydro Pump
moves.hydrosteam.flavor: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
moves.hydrosteam.name: Hydro Steam
moves.hydrovortex.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.hydrovortex.flavor: The user creates a huge whirling current using its Z-Power to swallow the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.hydrovortex.name: Hydro Vortex
moves.hyperbeam.desc: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.hyperbeam.flavor: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
moves.hyperbeam.name: Hyper Beam
moves.hyperdrill.flavor: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
moves.hyperdrill.name: Hyper Drill
moves.hyperfang.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.hyperfang.flavor: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.hyperfang.name: Hyper Fang
moves.hyperspacefury.flavor: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. This also lowers the user's Defense stat.
moves.hyperspacefury.name: Hyperspace Fury
moves.hyperspacehole.flavor: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
moves.hyperspacehole.name: Hyperspace Hole
moves.hypervoice.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.hypervoice.flavor: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.
moves.hypervoice.name: Hyper Voice
moves.hypnosis.flavor: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.
moves.hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
moves.iceball.desc: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.
moves.iceball.flavor: The user attacks the target for five turns. The move’s power increases each time it hits.
moves.iceball.name: Ice Ball
moves.icebeam.desc: Has a chance to freeze the target.
moves.icebeam.flavor: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
moves.icebeam.name: Ice Beam
moves.iceburn.desc: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.iceburn.flavor: The turn after using this move, the user surrounds the target with an ultracold, freezing wind to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.iceburn.name: Ice Burn
moves.icefang.desc: Has a chance to freeze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.icefang.flavor: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.
moves.icefang.name: Ice Fang
moves.icehammer.desc: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
moves.icehammer.flavor: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
moves.icehammer.name: Ice Hammer
moves.icepunch.desc: Has a chance to freeze the target.
moves.icepunch.flavor: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.
moves.icepunch.name: Ice Punch
moves.iceshard.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.iceshard.flavor: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.
moves.iceshard.name: Ice Shard
moves.icespinner.flavor: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.
moves.icespinner.name: Ice Spinner
moves.iciclecrash.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.iciclecrash.flavor: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.iciclecrash.name: Icicle Crash
moves.iciclespear.flavor: The user attacks by launching sharp icicles at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.iciclespear.name: Icicle Spear
moves.icywind.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.icywind.flavor: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.
moves.icywind.name: Icy Wind
moves.imprison.desc: Prevents the target from using any moves that the user also knows.
moves.imprison.flavor: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.
moves.imprison.name: Imprison
moves.incinerate.flavor: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.
moves.incinerate.name: Incinerate
moves.infernalparade.flavor: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.
moves.infernalparade.name: Infernal Parade
moves.inferno.desc: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.inferno.flavor: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.
moves.inferno.name: Inferno
moves.infernooverdrive.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.infernooverdrive.flavor: The user breathes a stream of intense fire toward the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies depending on the original move.
moves.infernooverdrive.name: Inferno Overdrive
moves.infestation.desc: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.infestation.flavor: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
moves.infestation.name: Infestation
moves.ingrain.desc: Prevents the user from leaving battle. User regains 1/16 of its max HP every turn.
moves.ingrain.flavor: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.
moves.ingrain.name: Ingrain
moves.instruct.desc: Forces the target to repeat its last used move.
moves.instruct.flavor: The user instructs the target to reuse the move last used by the target.
moves.instruct.name: Instruct
moves.iondeluge.desc: Changes all Normal moves to Electric moves for the rest of the turn.
moves.iondeluge.flavor: The user disperses electrically charged particles, which changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.
moves.iondeluge.name: Ion Deluge
moves.irondefense.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
moves.irondefense.flavor: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
moves.irondefense.name: Iron Defense
moves.ironhead.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.ironhead.flavor: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.ironhead.name: Iron Head
moves.irontail.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.irontail.flavor: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.irontail.name: Iron Tail
moves.ivycudgel.flavor: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.ivycudgel.name: Ivy Cudgel
moves.jawlock.desc: Prevents you and the target from switching out.
moves.jawlock.flavor: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.
moves.jawlock.name: Jaw Lock
moves.jetpunch.flavor: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.jetpunch.name: Jet Punch
moves.judgment.desc: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.
moves.judgment.flavor: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move's type changes depending on the kind of plate held by the user.
moves.judgment.name: Judgment
moves.jumpkick.desc: If the user misses, it takes half the damage it would have inflicted in recoil.
moves.jumpkick.flavor: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.
moves.jumpkick.name: Jump Kick
moves.junglehealing.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up.
moves.junglehealing.flavor: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
moves.junglehealing.name: Jungle Healing
moves.karatechop.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.karatechop.flavor: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.karatechop.name: Karate Chop
moves.kinesis.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.kinesis.flavor: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.
moves.kinesis.name: Kinesis
moves.kingsshield.desc: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact. Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.
moves.kingsshield.flavor: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also lowers the Attack stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.kingsshield.name: King’s Shield
moves.knockoff.flavor: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.
moves.knockoff.name: Knock Off
moves.kowtowcleave.flavor: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.
moves.kowtowcleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
moves.landswrath.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.landswrath.flavor: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.
moves.landswrath.name: Land’s Wrath
moves.laserfocus.desc: Guarantees a critical hit with the user’s next move.
moves.laserfocus.flavor: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
moves.laserfocus.name: Laser Focus
moves.lashout.desc: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.
moves.lashout.flavor: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.
moves.lashout.name: Lash Out
moves.lastresort.desc: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
moves.lastresort.flavor: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
moves.lastresort.name: Last Resort
moves.lastrespects.flavor: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.
moves.lastrespects.name: Last Respects
moves.lavaplume.desc: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.lavaplume.flavor: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.
moves.lavaplume.name: Lava Plume
moves.leafage.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.leafage.flavor: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
moves.leafage.name: Leafage
moves.leafblade.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.leafblade.flavor: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.leafblade.name: Leaf Blade
moves.leafstorm.desc: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
moves.leafstorm.flavor: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.leafstorm.name: Leaf Storm
moves.leaftornado.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.leaftornado.flavor: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.leaftornado.name: Leaf Tornado
moves.leechlife.desc: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.leechlife.flavor: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.leechlife.name: Leech Life
moves.leechseed.desc: Seeds the target, stealing HP from it every turn.
moves.leechseed.flavor: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
moves.leechseed.name: Leech Seed
moves.leer.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.leer.flavor: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.
moves.leer.name: Leer
moves.letssnuggleforever.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.letssnuggleforever.flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.
moves.letssnuggleforever.name: Let’s Snuggle Forever
moves.lick.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.lick.flavor: The user licks the target with a long tongue to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.lick.name: Lick
moves.lifedew.desc: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
moves.lifedew.flavor: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
moves.lifedew.name: Life Dew
moves.lightofruin.desc: User receives 1/2 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.lightofruin.flavor: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.lightofruin.name: Light of Ruin
moves.lightscreen.desc: Reduces damage from special attacks by 50% for five turns.
moves.lightscreen.flavor: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.
moves.lightscreen.name: Light Screen
moves.lightthatburnsthesky.desc: Inflicts damage using either Attack or Special Attack stat, whichever is higher.
moves.lightthatburnsthesky.flavor: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage— whichever stat is higher for the user, Necrozma. This move ignores the target’s Ability.
moves.lightthatburnsthesky.name: Light That Burns the Sky
moves.liquidation.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.liquidation.flavor: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
moves.liquidation.name: Liquidation
moves.lockon.desc: Ensures that the user’s next move will hit the target.
moves.lockon.flavor: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the user's next move does not miss that target.
moves.lockon.name: Lock-On
moves.lovelykiss.flavor: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.
moves.lovelykiss.name: Lovely Kiss
moves.lowkick.desc: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
moves.lowkick.flavor: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
moves.lowkick.name: Low Kick
moves.lowsweep.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.lowsweep.flavor: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.
moves.lowsweep.name: Low Sweep
moves.luckychant.desc: Prevents the target from scoring critical hits for five turns.
moves.luckychant.flavor: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits for five turns.
moves.luckychant.name: Lucky Chant
moves.luminacrash.flavor: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.luminacrash.name: Lumina Crash
moves.lunarblessing.flavor: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
moves.lunarblessing.name: Lunar Blessing
moves.lunardance.desc: User faints, and its replacement is fully healed.
moves.lunardance.flavor: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP and PP restored and its status conditions cured.
moves.lunardance.name: Lunar Dance
moves.lunge.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.lunge.flavor: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.lunge.name: Lunge
moves.lusterpurge.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
moves.lusterpurge.flavor: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.lusterpurge.name: Luster Purge
moves.machpunch.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.machpunch.flavor: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.machpunch.name: Mach Punch
moves.magicalleaf.flavor: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.
moves.magicalleaf.name: Magical Leaf
moves.magicaltorque.name: Magical Torque
moves.magiccoat.desc: Reflects back the first effect move used on the user this turn.
moves.magiccoat.flavor: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.
moves.magiccoat.name: Magic Coat
moves.magicpowder.desc: Causes the target to become a Psychic type.
moves.magicpowder.flavor: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target's type to Psychic.
moves.magicpowder.name: Magic Powder
moves.magicroom.desc: Negates held items for five turns.
moves.magicroom.flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
moves.magicroom.name: Magic Room
moves.magmastorm.desc: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.magmastorm.flavor: The user traps the target inside a maelstrom of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.magmastorm.name: Magma Storm
moves.magnetbomb.flavor: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.
moves.magnetbomb.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.magneticflux.desc: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of all friendly Pokémon with Plus or Minus by one stage.
moves.magneticflux.flavor: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.
moves.magneticflux.name: Magnetic Flux
moves.magnetrise.desc: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.
moves.magnetrise.flavor: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
moves.magnetrise.name: Magnet Rise
moves.magnitude.flavor: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies.
moves.magnitude.name: Magnitude
moves.makeitrain.flavor: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.
moves.makeitrain.name: Make It Rain
moves.maliciousmoonsault.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.maliciousmoonsault.flavor: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body using its Z-Power and crashes into the target with full force.
moves.maliciousmoonsault.name: Malicious Moonsault
moves.malignantchain.flavor: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
moves.malignantchain.name: Malignant Chain
moves.matblock.desc: Protects all friendly Pokémon from damaging moves. Only works on the first turn after the user is sent out.
moves.matblock.flavor: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.
moves.matblock.name: Mat Block
moves.matchagotcha.flavor: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.matchagotcha.name: Matcha Gotcha
moves.maxairstream.desc: If this move hits, raise the Speed of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.
moves.maxairstream.flavor: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.
moves.maxairstream.name: Max Airstream
moves.maxdarkness.desc: If this move hits, lower the Special Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.
moves.maxdarkness.flavor: This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.
moves.maxdarkness.name: Max Darkness
moves.maxflare.desc: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
moves.maxflare.flavor: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.
moves.maxflare.name: Max Flare
moves.maxflutterby.desc: If this move hits, lower the Special Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.
moves.maxflutterby.flavor: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.maxflutterby.name: Max Flutterby
moves.maxgeyser.desc: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
moves.maxgeyser.flavor: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.
moves.maxgeyser.name: Max Geyser
moves.maxguard.desc: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
moves.maxguard.flavor: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.maxguard.name: Max Guard
moves.maxhailstorm.desc: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.
moves.maxhailstorm.flavor: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.
moves.maxhailstorm.name: Max Hailstorm
moves.maxknuckle.desc: If this move hits, raise the Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.
moves.maxknuckle.flavor: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.
moves.maxknuckle.name: Max Knuckle
moves.maxlightning.desc: For five turns, prevents all Pokémon on the ground from sleeping and strengthens their Electric moves to 1.5× their power.
moves.maxlightning.flavor: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns.
moves.maxlightning.name: Max Lightning
moves.maxmindstorm.desc: Protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and increases the power of their Psychic moves by 50%.
moves.maxmindstorm.flavor: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for five turns.
moves.maxmindstorm.name: Max Mindstorm
moves.maxooze.desc: If this move hits, raise the Special Attack of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.
moves.maxooze.flavor: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.
moves.maxooze.name: Max Ooze
moves.maxovergrowth.desc: For five turns, heals all Pokémon on the ground for 1/16 max HP each turn and strengthens their Grass moves to 1.5× their power.
moves.maxovergrowth.flavor: This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns.
moves.maxovergrowth.name: Max Overgrowth
moves.maxphantasm.desc: If this move hits, lower the Defense of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.
moves.maxphantasm.flavor: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Defense stat.
moves.maxphantasm.name: Max Phantasm
moves.maxquake.desc: If this move hits, raise the Special Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.
moves.maxquake.flavor: This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.
moves.maxquake.name: Max Quake
moves.maxrockfall.desc: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
moves.maxrockfall.flavor: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.
moves.maxrockfall.name: Max Rockfall
moves.maxstarfall.desc: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion, and halves the power of incoming Dragon moves.
moves.maxstarfall.flavor: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for five turns.
moves.maxstarfall.name: Max Starfall
moves.maxsteelspike.desc: If this move hits, raise the Defense of the user and its allies' by 1 stage.
moves.maxsteelspike.flavor: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.
moves.maxsteelspike.name: Max Steelspike
moves.maxstrike.desc: If this move hits, lower the Speed of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.
moves.maxstrike.flavor: This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Speed stat.
moves.maxstrike.name: Max Strike
moves.maxwyrmwind.desc: If this move hits, lower the Attack of all Pokemon on the opposing side by 1 stage.
moves.maxwyrmwind.flavor: This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target’s Attack stat.
moves.maxwyrmwind.name: Max Wyrmwind
moves.meanlook.desc: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
moves.meanlook.flavor: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.meanlook.name: Mean Look
moves.meditate.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.
moves.meditate.flavor: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.
moves.meditate.name: Meditate
moves.mefirst.desc: Uses the target’s move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.
moves.mefirst.flavor: The user cuts ahead of the target to copy and use the target’s intended move with greater power. This move fails if it isn’t used first.
moves.mefirst.name: Me First
moves.megadrain.desc: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
moves.megadrain.flavor: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
moves.megadrain.name: Mega Drain
moves.megahorn.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.megahorn.flavor: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
moves.megahorn.name: Megahorn
moves.megakick.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.megakick.flavor: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
moves.megakick.name: Mega Kick
moves.megapunch.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.megapunch.flavor: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
moves.megapunch.name: Mega Punch
moves.memento.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.
moves.memento.flavor: The user faints. In return, the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats are harshly lowered.
moves.memento.name: Memento
moves.menacingmoonrazemaelstrom.flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target’s Ability.
moves.menacingmoonrazemaelstrom.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
moves.metalburst.desc: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.
moves.metalburst.flavor: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
moves.metalburst.name: Metal Burst
moves.metalclaw.desc: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
moves.metalclaw.flavor: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also boost the user's Attack stat.
moves.metalclaw.name: Metal Claw
moves.metalsound.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
moves.metalsound.flavor: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
moves.metalsound.name: Metal Sound
moves.meteorassault.desc: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
moves.meteorassault.flavor: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can’t move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.
moves.meteorassault.name: Meteor Assault
moves.meteorbeam.desc: Requires a turn to charge before attacking. Raises the users Special Attack by 1 stage after the first turn.
moves.meteorbeam.flavor: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
moves.meteorbeam.name: Meteor Beam
moves.meteormash.desc: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
moves.meteormash.flavor: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also boost the user’s Attack stat.
moves.meteormash.name: Meteor Mash
moves.metronome.desc: Randomly selects and uses any move in the game.
moves.metronome.flavor: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
moves.metronome.name: Metronome
moves.mightycleave.flavor: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
moves.mightycleave.name: Mighty Cleave
moves.milkdrink.desc: Heals the user by half its max HP.
moves.milkdrink.flavor: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.milkdrink.name: Milk Drink
moves.mimic.desc: Copies the target’s last used move.
moves.mimic.flavor: The user copies the move last used by the target. The copied move can be used until the user of Mimic leaves the battle.
moves.mimic.name: Mimic
moves.mindblown.desc: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
moves.mindblown.flavor: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.
moves.mindblown.name: Mind Blown
moves.mindreader.desc: Ensures that the user’s next move will hit the target.
moves.mindreader.flavor: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
moves.mindreader.name: Mind Reader
moves.minimize.desc: Raises the user’s evasion by two stages.
moves.minimize.flavor: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply boosts its evasiveness.
moves.minimize.name: Minimize
moves.miracleeye.desc: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
moves.miracleeye.flavor: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
moves.miracleeye.name: Miracle Eye
moves.mirrorcoat.desc: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.
moves.mirrorcoat.flavor: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.
moves.mirrorcoat.name: Mirror Coat
moves.mirrormove.desc: Uses the target’s last used move.
moves.mirrormove.flavor: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.
moves.mirrormove.name: Mirror Move
moves.mirrorshot.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.mirrorshot.flavor: The user lets loose a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.mirrorshot.name: Mirror Shot
moves.mist.desc: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.

moves.mistball.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.mistball.flavor: A mist-like flurry of down envelops and damages the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.mistball.name: Mist Ball
moves.mistyexplosion.desc: If Misty Terrain is active and the user is grounded, this move has its power increased by 50%.

moves.mistyexplosion.name: Misty Explosion

moves.mistyterrain.name: Misty Terrain
moves.moonblast.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.moonblast.flavor: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.moonblast.name: Moonblast
moves.moongeistbeam.flavor: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
moves.moongeistbeam.name: Moongeist Beam
moves.moonlight.desc: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.
moves.moonlight.flavor: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.moonlight.name: Moonlight
moves.morningsun.desc: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.
moves.morningsun.flavor: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.morningsun.name: Morning Sun

moves.mortalspin.name: Mortal Spin
moves.mountaingale.flavor: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.mountaingale.name: Mountain Gale
moves.mudbomb.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.mudbomb.flavor: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.mudbomb.name: Mud Bomb
moves.muddywater.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.muddywater.flavor: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.
moves.muddywater.name: Muddy Water
moves.mudshot.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
moves.mudshot.flavor: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
moves.mudshot.name: Mud Shot
moves.mudslap.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.mudslap.flavor: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
moves.mudslap.name: Mud-Slap
moves.mudsport.flavor: The user kicks up mud on the battlefield. This weakens Electric-type moves for five turns.
moves.mudsport.name: Mud Sport

moves.multiattack.name: Multi-Attack
moves.mysticalfire.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.mysticalfire.name: Mystical Fire
moves.mysticalpower.flavor: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
moves.mysticalpower.name: Mystical Power
moves.nastyplot.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.nastyplot.name: Nasty Plot

moves.naturepower.desc: Uses a move which depends upon the terrain.

moves.naturepower.name: Nature Power

moves.naturesmadness.name: Nature’s Madness
moves.needlearm.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.needlearm.name: Needle Arm

moves.nightslash.name: Night Slash

moves.oceanicoperetta.name: Oceanic Operetta

moves.octazooka.name: Octazooka

moves.odorsleuth.name: Odor Sleuth

moves.ominouswind.name: Ominous Wind

moves.originpulse.name: Origin Pulse
moves.outrage.desc: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.

moves.outrage.name: Outrage
moves.overdrive.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.overdrive.flavor: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.
moves.overdrive.name: Overdrive
moves.overheat.desc: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
moves.overheat.flavor: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.overheat.name: Overheat

moves.painsplit.name: Pain Split

moves.paraboliccharge.name: Parabolic Charge

moves.partingshot.name: Parting Shot

moves.payback.flavor: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.
moves.payback.name: Payback
moves.payday.desc: Scatters money on the ground worth five times the user’s level.
moves.payday.flavor: Coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.
moves.payday.name: Pay Day
moves.peck.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.peck.flavor: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn to inflict damage.
moves.peck.name: Peck

moves.perishsong.flavor: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
moves.perishsong.name: Perish Song
moves.petalblizzard.flavor: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.
moves.petalblizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.petaldance.desc: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
moves.petaldance.flavor: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
moves.petaldance.name: Petal Dance
moves.phantomforce.desc: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn. Hits through Protect and Detect.

moves.phantomforce.name: Phantom Force
moves.photongeyser.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.photongeyser.flavor: The user attacks the target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
moves.photongeyser.name: Photon Geyser
moves.pikapapow.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.pikapapow.flavor: The more Pikachu loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.
moves.pikapapow.name: Pika Papow

moves.plasmafists.name: Plasma Fists
moves.playnice.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.playnice.flavor: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.playnice.name: Play Nice

moves.playrough.flavor: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
moves.playrough.name: Play Rough

moves.pluck.flavor: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
moves.pluck.name: Pluck

moves.poisonfang.flavor: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
moves.poisonfang.name: Poison Fang
moves.poisongas.flavor: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the faces of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.
moves.poisongas.name: Poison Gas
moves.poisonjab.desc: Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.poisonjab.flavor: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
moves.poisonjab.name: Poison Jab
moves.poisonpowder.flavor: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.
moves.poisonpowder.name: Poison Powder
moves.poisonsting.desc: Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.poisonsting.flavor: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.
moves.poisonsting.name: Poison Sting
moves.poisontail.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
moves.poisontail.flavor: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.
moves.poisontail.name: Poison Tail

moves.pollenpuff.name: Pollen Puff

moves.pounce.name: Pounce

moves.powdersnow.name: Powder Snow

moves.powergem.name: Power Gem

moves.powershift.name: Power Shift

moves.powersplit.name: Power Split

moves.powertrick.flavor: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
moves.powertrick.name: Power Trick

moves.poweruppunch.name: Power-Up Punch

moves.powerwhip.name: Power Whip

moves.prismaticlaser.name: Prismatic Laser

moves.psyblade.name: Psyblade

moves.psychicfangs.name: Psychic Fangs

moves.psychicnoise.name: Psychic Noise

moves.psychoboost.name: Psycho Boost
