moves.smackdown.flavor: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.
moves.smackdown.name: Smack Down
moves.smartstrike.flavor: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
moves.smartstrike.name: Smart Strike
moves.smellingsalts.desc: If the target is paralyzed, inflicts double damage and cures the paralysis.
moves.smellingsalts.flavor: This attack’s power is doubled when used on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target’s paralysis, however.
moves.smellingsalts.name: Smelling Salts
moves.smog.desc: Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.smog.flavor: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.
moves.smog.name: Smog
moves.smokescreen.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.
moves.smokescreen.flavor: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target's accuracy.
moves.smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
moves.snaptrap.desc: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.snaptrap.flavor: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
moves.snaptrap.name: Snap Trap
moves.snarl.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.snarl.flavor: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.
moves.snarl.name: Snarl
moves.snatch.desc: Steals the target’s move, if it’s self-targeted.
moves.snatch.flavor: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing or stat-changing move.
moves.snatch.name: Snatch
moves.snipeshot.desc: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
moves.snipeshot.flavor: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.
moves.snipeshot.name: Snipe Shot
moves.snore.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch. Only works if the user is sleeping.
moves.snore.flavor: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
moves.snore.name: Snore
moves.snowscape.flavor: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.
moves.snowscape.name: Snowscape
moves.soak.desc: Changes the target’s type to Water.
moves.soak.flavor: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.
moves.soak.name: Soak
moves.softboiled.desc: Heals the user by half its max HP.
moves.softboiled.flavor: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.
moves.softboiled.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.solarbeam.desc: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
moves.solarbeam.flavor: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.
moves.solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
moves.solarblade.desc: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
moves.solarblade.flavor: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.
moves.solarblade.name: Solar Blade
moves.sonicboom.flavor: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.
moves.sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
moves.soulstealing7starstrike.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.soulstealing7starstrike.flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.
moves.soulstealing7starstrike.name: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike
moves.spacialrend.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.spacialrend.flavor: The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.spacialrend.name: Spacial Rend
moves.spark.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.spark.flavor: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.spark.name: Spark
moves.sparklingaria.flavor: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.
moves.sparklingaria.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.sparklyswirl.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.sparklyswirl.flavor: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also heals all status conditions of the user’s party.
moves.sparklyswirl.name: Sparkly Swirl
moves.spectralthief.desc: Steals the target’s stat increases, then inflicts damage.
moves.spectralthief.flavor: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.
moves.spectralthief.name: Spectral Thief
moves.speedswap.desc: Exchanges the user’s Speed with the target’s.
moves.speedswap.flavor: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
moves.speedswap.name: Speed Swap
moves.spicyextract.flavor: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.
moves.spicyextract.name: Spicy Extract
moves.spiderweb.desc: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
moves.spiderweb.flavor: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.
moves.spiderweb.name: Spider Web
moves.spikecannon.flavor: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
moves.spikecannon.name: Spike Cannon
moves.spikes.desc: Scatters Spikes, hurting opposing Pokémon that switch in.
moves.spikes.flavor: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.spikes.name: Spikes
moves.spikyshield.desc: Blocks damaging attacks and damages attacking Pokémon for 1/8 their max HP.
moves.spikyshield.flavor: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.
moves.spikyshield.name: Spiky Shield
moves.spinout.flavor: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.
moves.spinout.name: Spin Out
moves.spiritbreak.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.spiritbreak.flavor: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.spiritbreak.name: Spirit Break
moves.spiritshackle.flavor: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing.
moves.spiritshackle.name: Spirit Shackle
moves.spite.desc: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.
moves.spite.flavor: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
moves.spite.name: Spite
moves.spitup.desc: Power is 100 times the amount of energy Stockpiled.
moves.spitup.flavor: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.
moves.spitup.name: Spit Up
moves.splash.flavor: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
moves.splash.name: Splash
moves.splinteredstormshards.desc: Inflicts damage and removes any terrain present on the battlefield.
moves.splinteredstormshards.flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force. This move negates the effect on the battlefield.
moves.splinteredstormshards.name: Splintered Stormshards
moves.splishysplash.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.splishysplash.flavor: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon with paralysis.
moves.splishysplash.name: Splishy Splash
moves.spore.flavor: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
moves.spore.name: Spore
moves.spotlight.desc: Forces the target’s opponents to aim at the target for the rest of the turn.
moves.spotlight.flavor: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.
moves.spotlight.name: Spotlight
moves.springtidestorm.flavor: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.
moves.springtidestorm.name: Springtide Storm
moves.stealthrock.desc: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
moves.stealthrock.flavor: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
moves.steameruption.desc: Has a chance to burn the target.
moves.steameruption.flavor: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.steameruption.name: Steam Eruption
moves.steamroller.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.steamroller.flavor: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.steamroller.name: Steamroller
moves.steelbeam.desc: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
moves.steelbeam.flavor: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.
moves.steelbeam.name: Steel Beam
moves.steelroller.desc: Ends the effect of Electric, Grassy, Misty, or Psychic Terrains. Fails if no Terrain is active.
moves.steelroller.flavor: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.
moves.steelroller.name: Steel Roller
moves.steelwing.desc: Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by one stage.
moves.steelwing.flavor: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.
moves.steelwing.name: Steel Wing
moves.stickyweb.desc: Covers the opposing field, lowering opponents’ Speed by one stage upon switching in.
moves.stickyweb.flavor: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.
moves.stickyweb.name: Sticky Web
moves.stockpile.desc: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.
moves.stockpile.flavor: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.
moves.stockpile.name: Stockpile
moves.stokedsparksurfer.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.stokedsparksurfer.flavor: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force. This move leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.stokedsparksurfer.name: Stoked Sparksurfer
moves.stomp.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.stomp.flavor: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.stomp.name: Stomp
moves.stompingtantrum.desc: Has double power if the user’s last move failed.
moves.stompingtantrum.flavor: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
moves.stompingtantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.stoneaxe.flavor: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.
moves.stoneaxe.name: Stone Axe
moves.stoneedge.desc: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
moves.stoneedge.flavor: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
moves.stoneedge.name: Stone Edge
moves.storedpower.desc: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
moves.storedpower.flavor: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
moves.storedpower.name: Stored Power
moves.stormthrow.flavor: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
moves.stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
moves.strangesteam.desc: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.strangesteam.flavor: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.
moves.strangesteam.name: Strange Steam
moves.strength.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.strength.flavor: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.
moves.strength.name: Strength
moves.strengthsap.desc: Heals the user by the target’s current Attack stat and lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.
moves.strengthsap.flavor: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.strengthsap.name: Strength Sap
moves.stringshot.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
moves.stringshot.flavor: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.
moves.stringshot.name: String Shot
moves.struggle.desc: User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil.
moves.struggle.flavor: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also damages the user a little.
moves.struggle.name: Struggle
moves.strugglebug.desc: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
moves.strugglebug.flavor: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.
moves.strugglebug.name: Struggle Bug
moves.stuffcheeks.desc: User consumes berry and raises its defense by 2 stages.
moves.stuffcheeks.flavor: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.
moves.stuffcheeks.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.stunspore.flavor: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.
moves.stunspore.name: Stun Spore
moves.submission.desc: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
moves.submission.flavor: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.
moves.submission.name: Submission
moves.substitute.desc: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
moves.substitute.flavor: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.
moves.substitute.name: Substitute
moves.subzeroslammer.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.subzeroslammer.flavor: The user dramatically drops the temperature using its Z-Power and freezes the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.subzeroslammer.name: Subzero Slammer
moves.suckerpunch.desc: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
moves.suckerpunch.flavor: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
moves.suckerpunch.name: Sucker Punch
moves.sunnyday.desc: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
moves.sunnyday.flavor: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.
moves.sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
moves.sunsteelstrike.flavor: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.
moves.sunsteelstrike.name: Sunsteel Strike
moves.supercellslam.flavor: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
moves.supercellslam.name: Supercell Slam
moves.superfang.desc: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.
moves.superfang.flavor: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.
moves.superfang.name: Super Fang
moves.superpower.desc: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.superpower.flavor: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.
moves.superpower.name: Superpower
moves.supersonic.flavor: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.
moves.supersonic.name: Supersonic
moves.supersonicskystrike.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.supersonicskystrike.flavor: The user soars up with its Z-Power and plummets toward the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.supersonicskystrike.name: Supersonic Skystrike
moves.surf.desc: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
moves.surf.flavor: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
moves.surf.name: Surf
moves.surgingstrikes.desc: Hits three times. Always scores a critical hit.
moves.surgingstrikes.flavor: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.
moves.surgingstrikes.name: Surging Strikes
moves.swagger.desc: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.
moves.swagger.flavor: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.
moves.swagger.name: Swagger
moves.swallow.desc: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.
moves.swallow.flavor: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.
moves.swallow.name: Swallow
moves.sweetkiss.flavor: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
moves.sweetkiss.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.sweetscent.desc: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.
moves.sweetscent.flavor: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
moves.sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
moves.swift.flavor: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.swift.name: Swift
moves.switcheroo.flavor: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
moves.switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
moves.swordsdance.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.
moves.swordsdance.flavor: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.
moves.swordsdance.name: Swords Dance
moves.synchronoise.desc: Hits any Pokémon that shares a type with the user.
moves.synchronoise.flavor: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.
moves.synchronoise.name: Synchronoise
moves.synthesis.desc: Heals the user by half its max HP. Affected by weather.
moves.synthesis.flavor: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.synthesis.name: Synthesis
moves.syrupbomb.flavor: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
moves.syrupbomb.name: Syrup Bomb
moves.tachyoncutter.flavor: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
moves.tachyoncutter.name: Tachyon Cutter
moves.tackle.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.tackle.flavor: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.
moves.tackle.name: Tackle
moves.tailglow.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack by three stages.
moves.tailglow.flavor: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically boosting its Sp. Atk stat.
moves.tailglow.name: Tail Glow
moves.tailslap.flavor: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits two to five times in a row.
moves.tailslap.name: Tail Slap
moves.tailwhip.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.
moves.tailwhip.flavor: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.
moves.tailwhip.name: Tail Whip
moves.tailwind.desc: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
moves.tailwind.flavor: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.
moves.tailwind.name: Tailwind
moves.takedown.desc: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
moves.takedown.flavor: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.
moves.takedown.name: Take Down
moves.takeheart.flavor: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
moves.takeheart.name: Take Heart
moves.tarshot.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.
moves.tarshot.flavor: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.
moves.tarshot.name: Tar Shot
moves.taunt.desc: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
moves.taunt.flavor: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
moves.taunt.name: Taunt
moves.tearfullook.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage.
moves.tearfullook.flavor: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
moves.tearfullook.name: Tearful Look
moves.teatime.desc: All Pokemon on the field consume their held berries.
moves.teatime.flavor: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
moves.teatime.name: Teatime
moves.technoblast.desc: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.
moves.technoblast.flavor: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The move’s type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.
moves.technoblast.name: Techno Blast
moves.tectonicrage.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.tectonicrage.flavor: The user burrows deep into the ground and slams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.tectonicrage.name: Tectonic Rage
moves.teeterdance.flavor: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.
moves.teeterdance.name: Teeter Dance
moves.telekinesis.desc: Moves have 100% accuracy against the target for three turns.
moves.telekinesis.flavor: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
moves.telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
moves.teleport.desc: Immediately ends wild battles. No effect otherwise.
moves.teleport.flavor: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.
moves.teleport.name: Teleport
moves.temperflare.flavor: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
moves.temperflare.name: Temper Flare
moves.terablast.flavor: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
moves.terablast.name: Tera Blast
moves.terastarstorm.flavor: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
moves.terastarstorm.name: Tera Starstorm
moves.terrainpulse.desc: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.
moves.terrainpulse.flavor: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
moves.terrainpulse.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.thief.flavor: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.
moves.thief.name: Thief
moves.thousandarrows.desc: Grounds the target, and hits even Flying-type or levitating Pokémon.
moves.thousandarrows.flavor: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.
moves.thousandarrows.name: Thousand Arrows
moves.thousandwaves.desc: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
moves.thousandwaves.flavor: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can’t flee from battle.
moves.thousandwaves.name: Thousand Waves
moves.thrash.desc: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
moves.thrash.flavor: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
moves.thrash.name: Thrash
moves.throatchop.desc: Prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
moves.throatchop.flavor: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
moves.throatchop.name: Throat Chop
moves.thunder.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.thunder.flavor: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.thunder.name: Thunder
moves.thunderbolt.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.thunderbolt.flavor: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
moves.thundercage.desc: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.thundercage.flavor: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.thundercage.name: Thunder Cage
moves.thunderclap.flavor: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
moves.thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
moves.thunderfang.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.thunderfang.flavor: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
moves.thunderfang.name: Thunder Fang
moves.thunderouskick.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.thunderouskick.flavor: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
moves.thunderouskick.name: Thunderous Kick
moves.thunderpunch.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.thunderpunch.flavor: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.thunderpunch.name: Thunder Punch
moves.thundershock.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.thundershock.flavor: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.thundershock.name: Thunder Shock
moves.thunderwave.flavor: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.
moves.thunderwave.name: Thunder Wave
moves.tickle.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
moves.tickle.flavor: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.
moves.tickle.name: Tickle
moves.tidyup.flavor: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
moves.tidyup.name: Tidy Up
moves.topsyturvy.flavor: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
moves.topsyturvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.torchsong.flavor: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
moves.torchsong.name: Torch Song
moves.torment.desc: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.
moves.torment.flavor: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
moves.torment.name: Torment
moves.toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.
moves.toxic.flavor: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
moves.toxic.name: Toxic
moves.toxicspikes.desc: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.
moves.toxicspikes.flavor: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.toxicthread.desc: Poisons the target and lowers its Speed by one stage.
moves.toxicthread.flavor: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
moves.toxicthread.name: Toxic Thread
moves.trailblaze.flavor: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
moves.trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
moves.transform.desc: User becomes a copy of the target until it leaves battle.
moves.transform.flavor: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set.
moves.transform.name: Transform
moves.triattack.desc: Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
moves.triattack.flavor: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
moves.triattack.name: Tri Attack
moves.trick.flavor: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.
moves.trick.name: Trick
moves.trickortreat.desc: Adds Ghost to the target’s types.
moves.trickortreat.flavor: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
moves.trickortreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.trickroom.desc: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.
moves.trickroom.flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
moves.trickroom.name: Trick Room
moves.triplearrows.flavor: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.
moves.triplearrows.name: Triple Arrows
moves.tripleaxel.desc: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.
moves.tripleaxel.flavor: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
moves.tripleaxel.name: Triple Axel
moves.tripledive.flavor: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.
moves.tripledive.name: Triple Dive
moves.triplekick.desc: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.
moves.triplekick.flavor: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
moves.triplekick.name: Triple Kick
moves.tropkick.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
moves.tropkick.flavor: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
moves.tropkick.name: Trop Kick
moves.trumpcard.desc: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.
moves.trumpcard.flavor: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its power.
moves.trumpcard.name: Trump Card
moves.twinbeam.flavor: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
moves.twinbeam.name: Twin Beam
moves.twineedle.desc: Hits twice in the same turn. Has a chance to poison the target.
moves.twineedle.flavor: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.
moves.twineedle.name: Twineedle
moves.twinkletackle.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.twinkletackle.flavor: The user creates a very charming space using its Z-Power and totally toys with the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.
moves.twinkletackle.name: Twinkle Tackle
moves.twister.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.twister.flavor: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.
moves.twister.name: Twister
moves.upperhand.flavor: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
moves.upperhand.name: Upper Hand
moves.uproar.desc: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
moves.uproar.flavor: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
moves.uproar.name: Uproar
moves.uturn.desc: User must switch out after attacking.
moves.uturn.flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.uturn.name: U-turn
moves.vacuumwave.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.vacuumwave.flavor: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.
moves.vacuumwave.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.vcreate.desc: Lowers the user’s Defense, Special Defense, and Speed by one stage each.
moves.vcreate.flavor: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. This lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
moves.vcreate.name: V-create
moves.veeveevolley.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.veeveevolley.flavor: The more Eevee loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.
moves.veeveevolley.name: Veevee Volley
moves.venomdrench.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by one stage if it is poisoned.
moves.venomdrench.flavor: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
moves.venomdrench.name: Venom Drench
moves.venoshock.desc: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.
moves.venoshock.flavor: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
moves.venoshock.name: Venoshock
moves.victorydance.flavor: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.
moves.victorydance.name: Victory Dance
moves.vinewhip.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.vinewhip.flavor: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
moves.vinewhip.name: Vine Whip
moves.visegrip.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.visegrip.flavor: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
moves.visegrip.name: Vise Grip
moves.vitalthrow.flavor: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.
moves.vitalthrow.name: Vital Throw
moves.voltswitch.desc: User must switch out after attacking.
moves.voltswitch.flavor: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
moves.voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
moves.volttackle.desc: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.volttackle.flavor: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.
moves.volttackle.name: Volt Tackle
moves.wakeupslap.desc: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.
moves.wakeupslap.flavor: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. This also wakes the target up, however.
moves.wakeupslap.name: Wake-Up Slap
moves.waterfall.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.waterfall.flavor: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
moves.waterfall.name: Waterfall
moves.watergun.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.watergun.flavor: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
moves.watergun.name: Water Gun
moves.waterpledge.desc: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.
moves.waterpledge.flavor: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.
moves.waterpledge.name: Water Pledge
moves.waterpulse.desc: Has a chance to confuse the target.
moves.waterpulse.flavor: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.
moves.waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
moves.watershuriken.flavor: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.
moves.watershuriken.name: Water Shuriken
moves.watersport.flavor: The user soaks the battlefield with water. This weakens Fire-type moves for five turns.
moves.watersport.name: Water Sport
moves.waterspout.desc: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
moves.waterspout.flavor: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
moves.waterspout.name: Water Spout
moves.wavecrash.flavor: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.wavecrash.name: Wave Crash
moves.weatherball.desc: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.
moves.weatherball.flavor: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.
moves.weatherball.name: Weather Ball
moves.whirlpool.desc: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.whirlpool.flavor: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
moves.whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
moves.whirlwind.desc: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
moves.whirlwind.flavor: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
moves.wickedblow.flavor: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.
moves.wickedblow.name: Wicked Blow
moves.wickedtorque.name: Wicked Torque
moves.wideguard.desc: Prevents any multi-target moves from hitting friendly Pokémon this turn.
moves.wideguard.flavor: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
moves.wideguard.name: Wide Guard
moves.wildboltstorm.flavor: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.
moves.wildboltstorm.name: Wildbolt Storm
moves.wildcharge.desc: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
moves.wildcharge.flavor: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
moves.wildcharge.name: Wild Charge
moves.willowisp.flavor: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
moves.willowisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.wingattack.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.wingattack.flavor: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
moves.wingattack.name: Wing Attack
moves.wish.desc: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.
moves.wish.flavor: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.
moves.wish.name: Wish
moves.withdraw.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.
moves.withdraw.flavor: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.
moves.withdraw.name: Withdraw
moves.wonderroom.desc: All Pokémon’s Defense and Special Defense are swapped for 5 turns.
moves.wonderroom.flavor: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
moves.wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
moves.woodhammer.desc: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
moves.woodhammer.flavor: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.
moves.woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
moves.workup.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.
moves.workup.flavor: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.
moves.workup.name: Work Up
moves.worryseed.desc: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
moves.worryseed.flavor: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.
moves.worryseed.name: Worry Seed
moves.wrap.desc: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
moves.wrap.flavor: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.wrap.name: Wrap
moves.wringout.desc: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
moves.wringout.flavor: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the move’s power.
moves.wringout.name: Wring Out
moves.xscissor.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.xscissor.flavor: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.
moves.xscissor.name: X-Scissor
moves.yawn.desc: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.
moves.yawn.flavor: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
moves.yawn.name: Yawn
moves.zapcannon.desc: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
moves.zapcannon.flavor: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
moves.zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
moves.zenheadbutt.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.zenheadbutt.flavor: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.zingzap.desc: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
moves.zingzap.flavor: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.zingzap.name: Zing Zap
moves.zippyzap.desc: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
moves.zippyzap.flavor: The user attacks the target with bursts of electricity at high speed. This move always goes first and results in a critical hit.
moves.zippyzap.name: Zippy Zap
